formula_checks.name: theContributionRoom
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Calls monthly contribution ×12 money used so far, hides overcontributions by capping used at the limit, counts only Roth IRA amounts for combined IRA room, and assumes self-only HSA cover.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Use confirmed year-to-date contributions per person across relevant accounts, show excesses, use coverage/eligibility months, and distinguish planned annual contributions from used.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: His rulings G1 (DEC-0339), G10 (DEC-0243) and G36 (DEC-0336) are kept. Five points, each measured: (1) "used" capped at the limit hides an excess — APP WRONG (O-005-C04; the fix is in MK-CF-F-056 plus an excess figure on the door). (2) Monthly × 12 called "used" — NEEDS RULING: the app has no input for money already in this year and says on screen that it works from the monthly amount (O-005-C01). (3) Only the Roth IRA is counted — BLOCKED: the profile has no Traditional IRA contribution (c_roth only), though the card is titled "IRA (Traditional + Roth)". (4) Self-only HSA — BLOCKED: no cover input; the screen says "self-only limit; family plans cap higher". (5) Found while measuring: no birth year gives an unmarked base limit — APP WRONG under tenet 3 (O-005-C05). Minor, no wrong number today: the door's `today` does not reach the age (ageAttainedInYear reads the clock); production passes no `today`. The door also computes hsa.used / remaining that the room screen never shows (it prints HSA "up to" with used 0, per DEC-0013).
formula_checks.fixed_2026_10_25: FIXED 2026-10-25: points 1 (excess) and 5 (no birth year) fixed; point 2 DECIDED (plan arithmetic, said in words); points 3–4 stay BLOCKED (no Traditional IRA or HSA cover input). `today` now reaches the age too.
